onboarding1Title: Your family, close and at ease
onboarding1Body: Share your location when you want, let others know you're OK and ask your family for help if you need it.
onboarding2Body: Nobody can turn on your location for you. You can pause or stop sharing at any time and you'll always see who you share it with.
onboarding3Body: We'll ask for location and notification access when you turn on each feature, and explain why before we do.
onboarding4Title: A support, not an emergency service
onboarding4Body: Nexo Familia doesn't guarantee anyone's safety and doesn't replace official services. In an emergency, call {number}.
